cardData.backFlavor: Daniela always figured she had a good life. She had a loving, boisterous family. She had a steady job that used her brains and her hands. She had enough money to spend on fast cars, pretty girls, and her motorcycle, Gabriel. Then her brother, Ramon, got caught up in some trouble. Her mother warned her to be careful, that darkness lay ahead. Daniela set a glass of water behind the door for her mother's sake, to catch evil spirits - just as she'd been taught as a child. When Daniela awoke to find it shattered, she was determined to figure out what happened and fix it. Just like she always did.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 丹妮拉一直认为她拥有美好的生活。她有一个可爱的、热闹的家庭。她有一份自力更生的稳定工作。她有足够的钱花在跑车、漂亮女孩儿和自己的摩托车加百列上。但之后她的哥哥拉蒙遇上了一些麻烦。母亲警告过她要小心，黑暗将会接踵而至。丹妮拉在门后放了一杯水——母亲小时候教导她，说这样能抓住恶灵。当丹妮拉醒来，发现瓶子碎了，她便决定去找到毛病的源头，然后将其修正，一如既往。

cardData.backFlavor: The stars hold many secrets, and Norman was never one to ignore a mystery. So when six stars vanished from the sky, he simply couldn't let it go - not even when his colleagues told him he was just imaginging things. It took him years, and the near-death of his career, but he eventually found his answers in an ancient tome. It described the stars, and the sequence in which they would vanish, down to the very date and time. It was a sign, the book said, of the end of everything. It was the harbinger of a great beast that would tear asunder all that man had wrought. Norman isn't sure what he can do to stop the beast from destroying the world, but if the stars hold the answer, then he will find it.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 星星里藏有很多秘密，诺曼从不会忽略秘密。当六颗星星从天上消失时，诺曼简直无法接受——尽管他的同事告诉他那一切都是他的想象。他为此花费了好几年，还差点葬送职业生涯，但终于从一本古籍里找到了答案。它描述了星星以及它们消失的顺序，包括确切的日期和时间。书中说这是万物终结的一个信号。它预示了一只庞大的野兽将会撕碎人类所创造的一切。诺曼不知道该怎么做来阻止野兽摧毁世界，但如果星星知道答案，他将会找到答案。

cardData.backFlavor: Young Jack traveled the world with his father's archaeological expeditions. Now a globe-trotting treasure hunter and an accomplished archaeologist in his own right, "Monterey" follows in his father's footsteps, securing the treasures of ancient civilizations and lost cultures. But after discovering a silver pendant with a familiar symbol on it, Monterey must explore his own past. Years ago, his father was found murdered with the very same sigil carved in his forehead. The image has haunted Monterey's dreams ever since. But he's getting close. He won't stop until he solves the mystery of his father's murder... no matter what it takes.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 年轻的杰克跟随他父亲一起考古探险，环游世界。而如今他已是遍历全球的寻宝猎人，同时也是一个出色的考古学家，“蒙特雷”跟随他父亲的脚步，保护着古代文明和失落文化的宝藏。但当蒙特雷发现了一个带有熟悉符号的银色吊坠后，他决定去探索自己的过去。很多年前，他的父亲被杀害了，额头带有同样的符号。自此之后，那个画面一直出现在蒙特雷的梦境里。他已经快接近真相了。在找出杀害他父亲的凶手前，他是不会停下脚步的……无论付出多少代价。

cardData.backFlavor: Chen Li speaks rarely. When she does, her words are measured and wise. After a lifetime of disciplined training, every gesture is graceful, uncluttered by hesitation. The monks who raised her said that she was born for a special purpose, to face a great evil. Now, they believe that evil is at hand, and she is the only one who can stop it.

cardData.backFlavor: According to Bob, the secret to success as a salesman is persistence. People just need to be told what it is that they want. Repeatedly. Recently, Bob came into possession of a handful of "cursed" golden coins, and he hopes the same persistence he so famously advocates will help him to uncover their origin and purpose. If he plays his cards right, maybe this will be his big score. Maybe he'll finally be able to retire and buy that boat he's had his eye on and spend the rest of his days fishing in a tropical paradise. Or maybe Bob will finally come to see all that glitters is not gold.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 鲍勃认为，推销员的成功取决于坚持不懈。你只需要一遍又一遍地告知别人他们想要的是什么。最近，鲍勃拥有了几枚“被诅咒”的金币，他希望自己一向声名在外的坚持能够发现金币的起源与出现的原因。如果他不出差错的话，这将是一大成就。也许干完这票，他终于能退休，买下自己一直想要的那艘船，在热带天堂钓鱼度过余生。也许到最后，鲍勃会发现那些闪闪发光的其实并不是黄金。

cards.name: "Get behind me!"
cards.text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] window.
Until the end of the phase, whenever an enemy would attack another investigator at your location, it attacks you instead, then engages you. Cancel 1 horror dealt by each attack made in this way.
cards.textZh:
快速。可在任何[free]时间段期间打出。
直到本阶段结束，每次敌人攻击你所在地点的另一位调查员时，改为攻击你，然后与你交战。取消每次这种攻击造成的1点恐惧。

cards.name: On the Hunt
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you would draw an encounter card during the mythos phase.
Instead, search the encounter deck for an enemy, spawn it engaged with you (instead of its normal spawn location), attach On the Hunt to it, and shuffle the encounter deck.
[reaction] When you defeat attached enemy: Gain 3 resources.
cards.textZh:
快速。在神话阶段期间你将抽取遭遇卡牌时打出。
改为从遭遇牌库中查找一个敌人，将其生成并与你交战(而非在本来的位置生成它)，将追猎行动附属到该敌人上，并混洗遭遇牌库。
[reaction]在你击败被附属的敌人时：获得3资源。

cards.name: Archive of Conduits
cards.text:
Limit 1 per deck. As an additional cost to play this asset, place 1 resource on 4 different locations, as leylines.
[reaction] After you successfully investigate a location with a leyline, exhaust this asset: Move that leyline onto this asset. Then, if there are 4 leylines on it, discard it, take its leylines as resources, and record in your Campaign Log that "you have identified the gateway."
cards.textZh:
每套牌库仅限1张。作为打出本支援的额外费用，在4个不同地点放置1个资源，作为灵脉。

cards.name: Black Market
cards.text:
Fast. Play at the start of the investigation phase.
One at a time, reveal cards from the top of any investigator deck(s) until exactly 5 cards have been revealed. Set those cards aside, out of play. While set aside, any investigator may play any of those cards as if they were in their hand. At the start of the next investigation phase, shuffle each of those cards still set aside into its owner's deck.
cards.textZh:
快速。当调查阶段开始时打出。
从任意位调查员的牌库顶依次揭示卡牌，直到正好揭示5张卡牌。将这些卡牌放在一边，位于场外。这些卡牌放在一边时，任意调查员可以将其打出，如同是自己手牌。当下个调查阶段开始时，将这些卡牌中仍放在一边的洗回其所有者的牌库。

cards.name: Ice and Death
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the shelter value of your location (rounded up).
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (if you cannot, take 1 horror).

cards.textZh:
简单/普通
[skull]：-X。X等于你所在地点的庇护值的一半(向上取整)。
[cultist]：-2。如果你检定失败，将忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的1张卡牌混洗入你的牌库，不要查看内容(如果你不能这么做，受到1点恐惧)。
[tablet]：-3。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，弃掉你牌库顶的1张卡牌。抽取所有以此效果弃掉的弱点。
cards.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the shelter value of your location.
[cultist]: -2. For each point you fail by, shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (for each card you cannot shuffle, take 1 horror).
[tablet]: -4. For each point you fail by, discard the top card of your deck. Draw each weakness discarded by this effect.

cards.name: Cold Welcome
cards.text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
cards.textZh: 强制 - 调查员第一次进入一个地点后：将放在一边的地点中，所有与该地点相连的地点放置入场。(参考剧本手册中的地图摆放)。
cards.backText: Spawn a set-aside Skittering Nonsense at the lead investigator's location. Shuffle the remainder of the set-aside Skittering Nonsense enemies and the set-aside Creatures in the Ice encounter set into the encounter deck.
cards.backTextZh: 在调查员队长所在地点生成一个放在一边的疾行谬物。将剩余的放在一边的疾行谬物敌人，以及放在一边的冰中生物遭遇组混洗入遭遇牌库。

cardData.backFlavor:
"Hold on! Come see this!" one of the other team members shouts as you trudge ahead through the snow. You turn back and examine what they have found - a second set of tracks in the snow, but smaller, misshapen. Almost impossibly so.
"What in the hell could have made these tracks?" one of your party asks. You stand dumbfounded. Very little wildlife exists out here in the frozen wastes. And these tracks match nothing you've ever seen before. Nothing you can even imagine.
You don't have to question what could make such tracks for long. A shape emerges from the erupting snow, twisted and deformed, like a splotch of ink spilled upon the canvas of reality. It makes a strange, almost familiar cry that is eaten by the howling wind: "-li! -li!" Then, with terrifying speed, it rushes toward you.
cardData.backFlavorZh:
“等一下！来看下这个！”当你在雪地中艰难前行时，另一名队员喊道。你返回看看他们发现了什么——雪地上有另一组脚印，但是更小，而且是畸形的。这几乎不可能。
“到底是什么鬼东西留下了这些脚印？”团队中的一人问道。你目瞪口呆地站着。在这片冰冻荒原上，几乎没有野生动物存在。而且你从没见过有什么动物是这种脚印。你甚至无法想像这是什么生物。
但很快你就不用纠结这是什么东西的脚印了。 一道身影从喷发的雪中出现，扭曲变形，就像泼洒在现实画布上的墨点。 它发出一种奇怪的、有些熟悉的叫声，但被呼啸的狂风吞没了：“——哩！——哩！”然后，它以惊人的速度向你冲来。
cardData.backText: Spawn a set-aside Skittering Nonsense at the lead investigator's location. Shuffle the remainder of the set-aside Skittering Nonsense enemies and the set-aside Creatures in the Ice encounter set into the encounter deck.
cardData.backTextZh: 在调查员队长所在地点生成一个放在一边的疾行谬物。将剩余的放在一边的疾行谬物敌人，以及放在一边的冰中生物遭遇组混洗入遭遇牌库。
cardData.flavor: This isn't exactly how you imagined your first foray into the Antarctic wilds. The stinging cold and lashing, frozen winds will only get worse over time.
cardData.flavorZh: 这和你想像中第一次进入南极荒野不太一样。随着时间推移，刺骨的寒冷和鞭挞着你的冰冷寒风会让情况越来越糟。

cards.name: Into the White
cards.text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
cards.textZh: 强制 - 调查员第一次进入一个地点后：将放在一边的地点中，所有与该地点相连的地点放置入场。(参考剧本手册中的地图摆放)。
cards.backText: Spawn the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy at the revealed location with the highest shelter value.
cards.backTextZh: 将放在一边的星之恐怖敌人生成在已揭示的庇护值最高的地点。

cardData.backFlavor:
These things, these manifestations, they're not beasts or even alien creatures like those Dyer and Danforth encountered in their last expedition. You're not even sure they are entities at all. They have no shape, consisting of an almost proto-plasmic substance that seeps back into the ice when harmed or whenever you escape their clutches. Given the persistence of these entities and the inclement, deadly conditions of Antarctica, you know you won't survive the night without finding shelter.
Just as you are pondering what your next move should be, the ice beneath you rumbles with tremendous force, letting out a terrifying groan. "An earthquake?" one of your party asks over the raucous noise.
"No, that's impossible," another replies. You share a dreadful glance. Could it be one of those...things?
cardData.backFlavorZh:
这些东西，这些存在，它们不是野兽，甚至也不像戴尔和丹佛斯上次探险中遭遇的外星生物。你甚至不确定它们是不是实体。它们没有形状，由几乎像原生质一样的物质组成，当受到伤害或你逃脱它们的控制时，就会重新渗入冰雪之中。考虑到这些实体的存在，以及南极严酷致命的环境，你明白，如果找不到庇护所，你将无法熬过夜晚。
就在你思考下一步该怎么做的时候，你脚下的冰面开始剧烈震动，轰隆隆的巨响，发出可怕的呻吟。“地震？”团队中有人沙哑着嗓子问。
“不，这不可能。”另一人回答。你的眼神也充满畏惧。会不会也是那种……东西？
cardData.backText: Spawn the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy at the revealed location with the highest shelter value.
cardData.backTextZh: 将放在一边的星之恐怖敌人生成在已揭示的庇护值最高的地点。
cardData.flavor: Something dwells beneath the ice. Something you've never seen or heard of before, not even in William Dyer's horrifying report. Something...unreal.
cardData.flavorZh: 有什么东西潜伏在冰雪之下。那是你从没见过也没听过的，甚至在威廉·戴尔那可怕的报告中也未提及丝毫的东西。那是……非现实的东西。

Choose a location in play with no clues on it. Each undefeated investigator moves to that location and immediately resigns. The higher that location's shelter value, the better. cardData.backFlavor: You can go on no longer. It's not ideal, but you'll have to make do with the shelter you've found. You only hope that it's enough to keep your party from freezing... or worse.

cards.name: Search for a Camp Site
cards.text:
[action] If each investigator is at the same location and that location has no clues on it: Resign. You set up camp. Each investigator resigns.
Objective - Find somewhere safe to set up camp. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance. The higher the shelter value of the location they resigned at, the better.
cards.textZh:
[action]如果所有调查员都在同一地点，且该地点上没有线索：撤退。你扎起了营。所有调查员撤退。
目标 - 找到安全的地方扎营。如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退了，推进场景。他们撤退的地点的庇护值越高越好。

cardData.backFlavor: Exhausted and terrified by your ordeal, you decide this is as good a place as any to make camp for the night. Perhaps tomorrow you can salvage some kind of academic value out of this hellish journey, but for now such things seem trivial. Survival is the only thing on your mind.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 你经历苦难，现在筋疲力尽、惊恐不已。你决定这里是扎营过夜的好地方。也许明天你能从这地狱般的旅程中挖掘一些学术价值，但现在这些事情根本微不足道。你满脑子只想着活下去。
cardData.flavor: You're going to have to find a way back to camp, and soon...or you'll have to make due camping in the wilds.
cardData.flavorZh: 你得找到回营地的路，而且要尽快……不然你就只能在野外暂且扎营。

cardData.backFlavorZh: 当你穿越冰川荒野时，你偶然发现一组脚印，朝着远离营地的方向延伸。你停下来作进一步调查。这些足迹是你失踪的一名队员留下的吗？还是什么……更可怕的东西？
cardData.backText: Choose a facedown encounter card beneath a location. Look at the other side of that card (without resolving its text). Then return it facedown beneath that location.
cardData.backTextZh: 选择在一个地点底下的一张正面朝下的遭遇卡牌。查看该卡牌正面(不要结算其文字)。然后将其正面朝下放回该地点底下。
cardData.flavor: The low-hanging sun dimly illuminates the Antarctic night. Gray clouds cover the sky, threatening an icy storm.
cardData.flavorZh: 低垂的太阳照亮了南极的夜晚。天空乌云密布，预示着一场冰雪风暴即将来临。
cardData.name: The Chill of Night
cardData.packName: Edge of the Earth Campaign Expansion

cards.name: Madness and Death
cards.backText:
Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
(→R1)
cards.backTextZh:
剩下的每位调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤。
(→结局1)

cardData.backFlavor:
As the night ends, the storm arrives in its full ferocity. Raging, icy winds and dense snowfall make your task impossible. You'll never find the remaining team members in these conditions, and even if you did...
A hard lump of guilt and despair forms in your throat. There's no way they would survive in this storm, not without supplies or shelter. That you are forced to choose between your life and theirs is a burden you will surely carry with you for the rest of your life. And you'll be lucky if that's more than a couple of days.
cardData.backFlavorZh:
夜幕退散，风暴肆虐。凛冽的寒风和密集的大雪让你的任务失去了成功的可能。在这种情况下你永远也找不到剩下的团队成员，而即使你找到了……
一股强烈的内疚和绝望涌上你的喉咙。在这场风暴中，没有补给和庇护所，活下来是不可能的。你只能在双方的性命之间做取舍，这项决定会成为你一辈子的心理负担。当然，前提是你这辈子不会过几天就到头。
cardData.backText:
Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
(→R1)
cardData.backTextZh:
剩下的每位调查员被击败并承受1点精神创伤。
(→结局1)
cardData.flavor: The storm grows closer, and with it looming in the sky, that damnable sound returns. It haunts you with its presence, worming its way into your mind. Is it the cause of this folly? This madness?
cardData.flavorZh: 风暴越来越近，而随着它在天空中逼近，那该死的声音又回来了。它萦绕着你，钻进你的思想。是它造成了这场闹剧吗？还有这场疯狂？
cardData.name: Madness and Death
cardData.packName: Edge of the Earth Campaign Expansion

cards.name: The Lost Expedition
cards.text:
[fast] Investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the encounter card beneath your location.
[action] If you are at camp: Resign. You turn in for the night.
Objective - Find as many missing expedition members as you can by adding them to the victory display, then head back to camp before daybreak. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
cards.textZh:
[free]你所在地点的调查员共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索：抽取你所在地点底下的遭遇卡牌。
[action]如果你位于营地：撤退。你回来渡过夜晚。
目标 - 找到尽可能多的失踪探险队成员(将其加入胜利区)，然后在黎明到来前回到营地。如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退了，推进场景。

cardData.backFlavor: With night coming to a close, the storm approaches faster and faster. Soon, the weather will be too deadly for your search to continue. If anyone is still out there, you doubt they'll survive - and neither will you if you remain unsheltered any longer. You return to your camp, your heart heavy with guilt and and your mind addled by that foul noise that festers within.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 随着夜晚临近结束，风暴接近得越来越迅速了。很快，天气就会变得非常恶劣，你们将无法继续搜寻。如果还有人在外面，你怀疑他们是否还能活下来——当然，如果你也继续待在庇护所外面，那你也是一样的下场。你返回营地，你的心被沉重的罪恶感压迫着，而你的思想被你身体里那不断滋长的污秽声音所腐化。
cardData.flavor: You set out to search for the missing team members, hoping to find them before daybreak...
cardData.flavorZh: 你开始寻找失踪的队员，希望在黎明前找到他们……

cards.text:
Search your deck for a copy of Tekeli-li and place it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.
cards.textZh:

cardData.flavor:
As you traverse the glacial wilds, something rumbles and churns beneath your feet. Is that where these creatures are coming from? In the depths of the ice?
A somber thought crosses your mind. If you are right, such entities could exert their vile influence no matter where you stand. Perhaps this has something to do with your missing companions after all, though there are no signs of them here.
cardData.flavorZh:
当你穿越冰川荒野时，有东西在你脚下搅动，隆隆作响。这些生物就是从那里来的吗？从冰雪深处？
一个严峻的想法掠过你的脑海。如果你是对的，那不管你在哪里，都逃不出这些存在的魔爪。也许这跟你失踪的同伴有关系，尽管这里没有他们的踪迹。

cardData.flavor: You come across evidence of one of your lost companions, abandoned and half-buried in snow - torn scraps from a heavy fur coat and a pair of goggles. Examining the goggles closely yields a terrifying discovery - a dark, sticky substance that you cannot, for the life of you, identify.
cardData.flavorZh: 你偶然发现了一个失踪同伴的迹象，是厚重毛皮大衣上撕下的碎片和一副护目镜，被遗弃在这里，半埋在雪中。仔细检查护目镜，你发现一些可怕的事情——一种你无论如何也认不出的黑色粘稠物质。

cards.text:
Remove 1 [frost] token from the chaos bag.
Add this story card to the victory display.
cards.textZh:
从混乱袋里移除1个[frost]标记。

cardData.flavor:
The tracks continue for some time before vanishing, bafflingly, into the snow. There's no sign of any struggle, nor are there any other tracks that might indicate where they could have gone. Could the winds have covered the tracks? And if so, why were you able to follow the rest of the footprints so easily?
But when you turn back to examine the prints you first followed, they too are gone.
cardData.flavorZh:
足迹持续了一段，然后莫名其妙地消失在雪地中。没有任何挣扎的迹象，也没有任何其他痕迹可以表明他们可能去了哪里。难道是狂风将足迹掩埋了吗？但如果是这样，为什么你能这么轻易的追踪到之前的脚印呢？
你转身想检查一路跟来的脚印，却发现它们也消失了。

cardData.flavor: You follow a set of tracks into a small cavern carved into a glacial wall, and your stomach lurches at the sight before you. One of your missing team members lies in a crumpled heap at the end of the hollow, his clothing torn open. A clean vertical incision has bisected his torso open from his sternum to his belly, and his entrails have been carefully removed. You struggle not to retch. Who could have possibly done such a thing?
cardData.flavorZh: 你跟着一组脚印进入了一个在冰川峭壁上凿出的小洞穴，而看到眼前的景象，你的胃痉挛起来。一名失踪队员躺在坑洞尽头，衣服被撕开了。一道利落的切口从他的胸口切开到腹部，他的内脏被小心地取走了。你努力不让自己呕吐。谁会做出这样的事？

cardData.flavor: You are fleeing from a creature made of kaleidoscopic ooze when you suddenly freeze in place, a web of cracks reaching out across the ice beneath your boots. Your breath catches in your throat. Another step could spell your doom or save your life. Behind you, the entity gains on you, reaching out with arms that are not quite solid or liquid. Feeling lucky, you decide to roll the dice, striking the ground behind you and fleeing to the side. Just as you hoped, the ice is thin enough to splinter open, and the creature tumbles down through the crack, into the icy depths. You breathe a sigh of relief, thankful you did not share a similar fate.
cardData.flavorZh: 你正在逃离一个由千变万化的软泥组成的生物时，突然停了下来，脚下的冰面上布满了裂缝。你大气不敢出一口。再走一步，你就可能万劫不复，或者小命得救。在你身后，那个实体渐渐靠近你，伸出既不完全是固体也不完全是液体的手臂。你想试试运气，决定孤注一掷，猛击身后的冰面并逃到一边。正如你所希望的，冰面足够薄从而裂开，那生物掉进裂缝，去往深处。你松了一口气，还好下去的不是自己。

cardData.flavor: You follow a set of footprints through the snow, hoping they will lead you to a sign, any sign, of your lost companions. Sadly, the evidence you discover is not the kind you were hoping to find. Where the prints end, you find an ice pick covered in freshly frozen blood. To your horror, a human eye lies nearby, staining the snow red. A shudder creeps up your spine. What on Earth could compel somebody to do such a thing?
cardData.flavorZh: 你跟着雪地上的一组脚印，希望它们能指引你找到失踪同伴的任何迹象。遗憾的是，你找到的迹象并不是你想要的那种。在脚印的尽头，你发现一个覆盖着新鲜冻血的破冰锥。令你惊恐的是，旁边放着一个人类的眼珠，把雪染成了红色。你的脊梁上冒出寒气，忍不住打了个寒颤。究竟是什么迫使一个人做出这种事情？

cardData.flavor: To your relief, you come across one of your missing team members - but they are not themself. Their eyes glazed over, their expression dazed and lost. A murky, slimy substance drips from their face and trickles onto the ice below. When you finally manage to get through to them, they wipe the strange, inky miasma from their face, staining their cheeks black. "What...was I doing?" they ask.
cardData.flavorZh: 让你松一口气的是，你遇到了一名失踪的队员——但已经面目全非了。对方目光呆滞，神情茫然。一种浑浊、粘稠的物质从这名队员的脸上滴下来，落到下面的冰面上。当你最终准备接近，对方擦拭着脸上奇怪、墨黑的瘴气，脸颊都染成了黑色。“我在……做什么？”那人问道。

cards.name: Icy Depths
cards.backText: Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
cards.backTextZh: 剩下的每位调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。

cardData.backFlavor:
Your only warning is a thin web of cracks that tears through the ice before your feet, and then a sudden explosion of mist and ink-like miasma erupts around you. The force slams you to the ground. You crawl desperately along the freezing-cold ice as the miasma reaches for you. An incomprehensible sound, like the rushing of a furious whirlwind, fills your ears. Then a thunderous crack, and you are falling - no, sliding - down along the ice toward the freezing cold waters below.
It is a wonder you are even still conscious. You summon all of your strength and cling to the ice shelf just before you plummet below. You finally haul yourself back over the edge, casting a panicked glance at the horizon, but there is no sign of any miasma or mist. The crack in the ice shelf extends for hundreds of feet in front of you, separating you from your pursuers. Somehow, you've unwittingly escaped...although you won't be forgetting that near-death experience anytime soon.
cardData.backFlavorZh:
你唯一的警告就是你脚前的冰面上出现了薄薄一层裂缝，然后你周围突然爆发出雾气和墨般的瘴气。这股力量将你击倒在地。你绝望地在冰冷的冰面上爬行，瘴气向你袭来。一种难以理解的声音像一阵狂暴的旋风一样，震耳欲聋。然后是一声雷鸣般的巨响，你就掉下去了——不，是沿着冰面滑向下面冰冷的海水。
你还有意识简直是个奇迹。就在你掉下去之前，你鼓起所有的力量抓住了冰架。你终于爬上边缘，惊慌失措地瞥了一眼地平线，但没有任何瘴气或薄雾的迹象。冰架上的裂缝在你面前延伸数百英尺，将你与追捕者分开。你不知不觉地就逃了出来……尽管那次濒死体验你很长时间都忘不了。
cardData.backText: Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
cardData.backTextZh: 剩下的每位调查员被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。
cardData.flavor: The violent quakes have risen to a crescendo. Any second now, you feel as though the entire ice shelf could collapse, spilling you into the frigid ocean - or worse, if your theory about the underground source of these creatures is correct.
cardData.flavorZh: 强烈的地震已达到高潮。现在起的每一秒，你都觉得整个冰架可能崩塌，把你扔进冰冷的海洋——或者更糟，如果你关于这些生物来自地下的推论是正确的话。

cards.name: Under Attack!
cards.text:
Each [[Eidolon]] enemy gains Victory 0.
The camp gains: "[action] Investigators at your location spend 4 clues, as a group: Resign."
Objective - If there are no [[Eidolon]] enemies in play, advance.
Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
cards.textZh:
每个[[幻灵]]敌人获得胜利0。
营地获得：“[action]你所在地点的调查员共同花费4个线索：撤退。”
目标 - 如果场上没有[[幻灵]]敌人，推进场景。
目标 - 如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退了，推进场景。
cards.backText:
If there are no [[Eidolon]] enemies in play:
The last of the nightmarish creatures falls, its miasmatic body at once dissolving into inky, prismatic liquid and dissipating into wisps of gray mist filled with screaming shapes. Then, silence.
(→R1)
If the investigators advanced by resigning:
You follow a makeshift path through a jagged split in the ice shelf, making your way deeper into the mainland, toward the mountains. You don't know if these creatures can follow human tracks - or indeed if they need tracks at all in order to pursue you - but you take the time to cover them, regardless. Hopefully, with this shortcut you've found, you'll be safe...
(→R2)
cards.backTextZh:
如果场上没有[[幻灵]]敌人：
最后的可怕生物倒下了，它瘴气似的身体立刻融化成墨状的五彩液体，然后消散成一缕缕形状诡异的灰色雾气。然后，一切归于沉寂。
(→结局1)
如果调查员通过撤退来推进场景：
你沿着一条简易小路穿过冰架的锯齿状裂缝，进入大陆深处，走向山脉。你不知道这些生物是否会跟随人类的足迹——或者它们是否需要人类的足迹来追赶你——但无论如何，你都要花时间来掩盖它们。希望有了这条你找到的捷径，你会变安全些……
(→结局2)

cardData.backFlavor:
Bit by bit, your consciousness fades. You are lost in the ever-expanding weave of memories, your senses drowning in a deluge of thought and emotion. A jumbled cage of fear, doubt, and horror.
When you finally awaken, only seconds have passed.
cardData.backFlavorZh:
你的意识正在一点一点地消失。你迷失在不断膨胀的记忆交织之中，你的感官淹没在思想和情感的洪流之中。一个混杂着恐惧、怀疑和恐怖的囚笼。
当你最终醒来时，时间却只过了几秒钟。

cards.name: Shadow of the Past (v. I)
cards.text: Objective - Confront your demons to strengthen your resolve. (Hint: You may have more than one opportunity to advance this act. Until then, you are trapped. If you are running out of time and are given the chance to advance, consider taking it...)
cards.textZh: 目标 - 直面内心的恶魔，坚定你的决心。(提示：你可能有不止一次机会来推进本场景。在那之前，你都被困住了。如果你在时限将尽时正好可以推进，不妨考虑抓住机会……)

cardData.backFlavor:
Understanding sets in. Dream though it may be, this place is like a nexus of minds - a place within the miasma where thought is material. Where madness is embodied.
As you ponder the deeper truths that might have taken shape in this maze of horrors, a door appears just in the periphery of your sight: the same door you once used to trap yourself in this hellish place.
Perhaps there are more mysteries to discover here, but for now, you've seen enough. You open the door...
cardData.backFlavorZh:
你开始理解了。尽管可能是梦，但这个地方就像思想的中枢——笼罩于瘴气之中，思想是实体的地方。在这里，疯狂也会具象化。
当你在思考，这恐怖迷宫中可能存在的深层真相时，一扇门恰好出现在你视线的边缘：正是通过那扇门你才被关在这鬼地方。
也许这里还有更多的谜团有待探索，但现在，你已经看得够多了。你打开了门……
cardData.flavor: In this strange, alternate reality, past memories and nightmares come to life. Is this place real or a figment of your imagination? Or perhaps both?
cardData.flavorZh: 在这个离奇的异世界，过去的记忆和噩梦化为现实。这个地方是真实的还是你想像出来的？或者可能都是？

Hallucination or not, it is your only way out of this strange place. Maybe the truth is out there, somewhere, but for now, it's safer to leave and return to reality. You open the door...
cardData.backFlavorZh: 再一次，当你想知道这个地方拥有的更深层次的意义时，出口出现在你面前，一扇坚实的橡木门在幻景中突兀显现。无论是不是妄想，这是你离开这个奇怪地方的唯一途径。也许真相就在某处，但现在，离开回到现实中更安全。你打开了门……

cardData.backFlavor: As you confront yet another memory locked inside this strange hallucination, you spot another door - not a wooden one or indeed any door made by human hands, but rather a colossal circular gate of rock with an elaborately carved slab of slate-gray stone blocking your way. Enigmatic glyphs wind around its frame, their meaning inscrutable. You step forward, place your hand upon the stone, and to your surprise, the door cracks open with an immense rumble. A layer of thick, prismatic miasma drips from the doorway as you peer inside. Thum-thum. Thum-thum. Thum-thum. The beating is tremendous. Something quivers and throbs on the other side, something hideous and enormous, like a beating heart. Thum-thum. Thum-thum. Thum-thum. The heart of the mountain. The heart of the mirage. Then the door slams open, tendrils of ichor slap around your wrists, and you are dragged, screaming, through the door-
cardData.backFlavorZh:
当你在这个奇怪的幻觉中面对另一段记忆时，你发现了另一扇门——不是木制的，也不是经由人类之手做出的门，而是一扇巨大的，精心雕刻着灰色石板的圆形石门挡住了你的路。高深莫测的象形文字缠绕在它的门框上，其含义难以理解。你走上前，把你的手放在石头上，令你吃惊的是，随着一声巨大的隆隆声，门开了。
当你往里面看的时候，一层厚厚的五光十色的瘴气从门口溢出。咚-咚。咚-咚。咚-咚。节拍声震耳欲聋。另一边有什么东西在颤抖抽搐，一种可怕而巨大的东西，就像一颗跳动的心脏。咚-咚。咚-咚。咚-咚。山脉之心。幻景之心。然后门砰的一声开了，脓肿的卷须拍打在你的手腕上，你被拖着，尖叫着穿过了门——

“放松。我可不是独自一人。”伊里亚回答道，他戴着手套的手轻轻地抚摸着安雨的脖子。
医师翻了个白眼离开了，但高田抱着双臂，依然留在那里。“在我们出发之前还有很多事情要做，你知道的吧。”她说。

高田点头。“是的。我也感觉到了。”

"It is foolish to venture out alone," Dr. Sinha joins in the scolding.
"Relax. I wasn't alone," Eliyah replies, his gloved hand gently petting Anyu's neck.

Takada nods. "Yes. I feel it, too."

cardData.flavor:
Ellsworth appears in a shimmer of mirage-light, staring out over the railing into the cold, blue ocean. "Beautiful, isn't it?" he says.
Cookie and Claypool appear nearby, carrying several crates of supplies between them. "Y'know what would be beautiful?" Cookie hollers. "If maybe yeh helped out a lil' bit. Think yeh might get off yer ass for a minute 'n pitch in, Ellsworth?"
The explorer nods with a soft sigh and takes the weight from Claypool's hands, nodding aside for him to take a break. Claypool gives him a gentle, knowing smile.
cardData.flavorZh:
埃尔斯沃思出现在闪烁的幻光中，凝视着栏杆外冰冷的蓝色海洋。
“很美，不是吗？”他说。
曲奇和克莱普尔出现在旁边，他们中间还有几箱补给品。“那你想知道什么事情更美吗？”曲奇大喊着。“比如你现在就来搭把手。埃尔斯沃思，你能不能动一下，过来帮帮忙？”
探险家轻轻叹了口气，点了点头，接过克莱普尔手中的东西，向旁边点了下头，让克莱普尔休息一下。克莱普尔给了他一个温柔的、会心的微笑。

cardData.flavor:
Three figures shimmer into view as they cross one another in the darkened halls. "Professor," you hear Dr. Kensler's voice acknowledge, and her outline becomes defined. Professor Dyer and his protégé appear next. "I do hope you'll consider my proposal," she continues. If she truly cared one way or the other, her tone of voice surely does not reveal it.
In response, Dyer simply glances at Danforth, who appears to be staring behind her - far, far behind her. "Well. In any event..." she adjusts her glasses, and enters the door labeled with her name.
Dyer shakes his head with a sigh, but Danforth is the one who breaks the silence. "I...I think we should go."
cardData.flavorZh:
三个人影在昏暗的礼堂里互相交错，闪着微光出现在你的视线中。“教授。”你听到肯斯勒博士的声音，她的轮廓变得清晰起来。戴尔教授和他的学生紧接着出现了。“我真的希望你能考虑我的建议。”她继续说。如果她真的如她所言那么在乎，至少从她的语气完全听不出来。
作为回应，戴尔只是瞥了丹佛斯一眼，丹佛斯似乎正盯着她身后——远处，非常远。
“好吧。不论如何……”她调整了一下眼镜，走进了贴着她名字的门。
戴尔摇摇头，叹了口气，但是丹佛斯打破了沉默。“我……我认为我们应该去。”

cardData.flavor: "You really think I can't navigate a simple maze?" Ellsworth chuckles. He looks several years younger and wears a proper tuxedo instead of his comfortable jacket and trousers. The figure he speaks to stands just out of view, a dark silhouette with a muffled, indistinct voice. "Fine," the explorer replies with a roll of his eyes. He hands the figure his champagne glass and loosens his tie. "But when I get back, you are going to tell me what this is really all about."
cardData.flavorZh: “你真的认为我连一个简单的迷宫都走不来吗？”埃尔斯沃思轻声笑着。他看起来年轻了好几岁，穿着得体的燕尾服，而不是舒适的夹克和裤子。和他说话的那个人恰好在视线之外，一个黑色的剪影，声音低沉而模糊。“好吧。”探险家翻了个白眼回答道。他把香槟酒杯递给那个人，松了松领带。“但等我回来，你要告诉我这到底是怎么回事。”

cardData.flavor:
When Eliyah materializes into view, you are stunned to see him without his steadfast companion, Anyu. He holds an unfamiliar woman's hands, her wavy hair the color of a brilliant ruby. The two young lovers stare into one another's eyes as the old train approaches. "How long do you think you will be gone?"
"I...I'm not sure," he confesses. "It is a lengthy journey. Alaska is a hell of a big place."
"So, this is goodbye, then," the woman says. She wipes angry tears from her eyes. "Will you write?"
"I'll try, but..." he glances away.
"Right, right," she says, understanding. The train pulls into the station, its piercing squeal muffling their words. "You...fool." She leans up and kisses his cheek. "You are a fool, Eliyah."
"I...I know," he replies. "I know."
cardData.flavorZh:
当伊里亚出现在你的视线中时，你惊讶地发现他身边没有一直陪伴着他的伙伴安雨。他握着一个陌生女子的手，她有着灿烂红宝石般颜色的卷发。当老旧的火车驶近时，这对年轻的恋人互相凝视着对方的眼睛。“你预计你要去多久？”
“我……我也不清楚。”他坦白，“这是一次漫长的旅程。阿拉斯加真是个大地方。”
“所以，这就是永别了吧。”女子说道。她擦去眼中愤怒的泪水。“你会写信给我吗？”
“我尽力，但是……”他把目光移开。
“好吧，好吧。”她说道，表示明白。火车进站了，刺耳的汽笛声盖过了他们说的话。“你……大傻瓜。”她踮起脚，亲吻了他的脸颊。“你是个大傻瓜，伊里亚。”
“我……我知道。”他回答，“我知道的。”

"Get used to it!" Takada shouts from the pilot's seat. "Weather's gonna be rough anytime we're in the air. Don't worry though, she'll hold." You see the grim copilot hold back a smile. "You're enjoying this, aren't you?" Takada chimes.

cardData.flavorZh:
“这该死的试飞！”曲奇的喊声盖过了呼啸的疾风。他俩在高田的一架飞机上——这一定是发生在你们出发前往那些山峰之前，她完成第一架飞机的工作后，紧接着发生的事情。
“习惯一下吧！”高田坐在飞行员的座位上高喊。“我们在空中，任何时候天气都会很恶劣。不过别担心，她撑得住。”你看到冷酷的副驾驶在强忍着笑。“你很享受，是吧？”高田调侃道。
“啥呀？”曲奇撒谎道，“只是时间长有点无聊罢了。”

cardData.flavor:
These are the sledges missing from Lake's camp," Professor Dyer remarks, shimmering into view. He doesn't sound particularly surprised - it seems they must have accounted for this possibility.
Danforth is already at the first of the sledges, examining its contents. "Here's the gasoline stove, the fuel, all of their research instruments..." he trails off. "God, what is that awful stench?" He motions toward the farthest sledge, the tarpaulin strapped around its cargo bulging oddly.
"Danforth, don't-" Dyer calls out, but it's too late. The moment Danforth removes the tarpaulin, he staggers backward, covering his mouth and nose. Frozen and preserved beneath the tarpaulin are the corpses of a young explorer and one of his sled dogs.
"Gedney," Dyer whispers.
cardData.flavorZh:
“这些是莱克营地失踪的雪橇。”戴尔教授边说着边闪着光出现在视线中。听起来他并没有特别惊讶——似乎他们已经预见了这种可能性。
丹佛斯已经走到第一辆雪橇前面，检查雪橇里的东西。“这是燃油炉、燃料，还有他们所有的研究仪器……”他声音越来越小。“天哪，这是什么臭味？”他朝最远的那架雪橇走去，捆在货物上的油布奇怪地鼓起。
“丹佛斯，别——”戴尔喊着，但已经太迟了。丹佛斯刚把油布拿开，就摇摇晃晃地后退了几步，捂住了嘴和鼻子。油布下面冻着一位年轻探险家和他的一只雪橇犬的尸体。
“格德尼。”戴尔低语

cardData.flavor:
"Thank you for...for inviting me here, Dr. Sinha," Dr. Kensler says quietly, her outline shimmering into view. She and Dr. Sinha sit next to one another in the almost-empty theatre. The lights are dim and the curtain drawn, but the show has not yet begun.
"Of course. And just Mala is fine."
Kensler flinches and clears her throat. "Then call me Amy."
"I already do," the physician replies as the screen in front of them kindles to life.
cardData.flavorZh:
“谢谢你……邀请我来这里，辛哈医生。”肯斯勒博士轻声说着，她的轮廓闪烁着出现在视线中。她和辛哈医生坐在几乎空无一人的剧院里。灯光昏暗，帷幕揭起，但演出还没有开始。
“当然。还有叫我玛拉就行。”
肯斯勒畏缩了一下，然后清了清嗓子。“那你可以叫我艾米。”
“我已经这么做啦。”医师回复着，她们面前的荧幕开始变亮。

cardData.flavor:
Claypool stares up at the ruins with a twinkle of wonder in his eyes. "Marvelous, isn't it, William?" Behind him, Professor Dyer materializes within the mirage. Both of them are at least a decade younger, perhaps more. You note Claypool did not address the professor by his title.
"Marvelous and mysterious," Dyer replies. "Nobody knows the true purpose of this site. Perhaps nobody ever will."
"But that's why we do this, right?" Claypool says with a grin. "To learn the truth."
Dyer glances back at the youth, lines of worry pulling at his eyes. "Yes," he whispers, "the truth."
cardData.flavorZh:
克莱普尔抬头凝视着遗迹，眼中闪烁着惊奇的光芒。“太了不起了，是不是，威廉？”在他身后，戴尔教授在幻景中出现了。他们两人都至少年轻十岁，也许更多。你注意到克莱普尔没有称呼教授的头衔。
“奇妙而神秘。”戴尔回答，“没有人知道这里的真正用途。也许以后也不会有人知道。”
“但这就是我们这么做的原因，对吧？”克莱普尔笑着说，“为了了解真相。”
戴尔回头看了一眼那个年轻人，他的眼角拉出忧虑的皱纹。“是的。”他低语道，“真相。”

cardData.flavor: A teenage girl shimmers into view. You recognize Takada's chestnut eyes and thin, straight hair. Her cheeks are stained with tears and rain. She waves as the old, rickety aeroplane takes off. You don't recognize the design - this must have been over a decade ago. "Don't worry, kiddo." The man next to her grips her shoulder encouragingly. "He'll be back soon," he reassures her, his voice soft with compassion. "You'll see."
cardData.flavorZh: 一个十几岁的女孩闪烁着出现在视线中。你认出高田栗色的眼睛和纤细的直发。她的脸颊被泪水和雨水弄脏了。当那架摇摇晃晃的老旧飞机起飞时，她挥着手。你并不认识这种设计——这一定是十多年前的事了。“别担心，孩子。”她旁边的男人抓住她的肩膀鼓励她。“他很快就会回来的。”他安慰她说，他的声音温柔而富有同情心，“你就等着吧。”

cardData.flavor: Eliyah sits huddled up against a tree, a torrent of snow falling around him. In his arms, Anyu whines. Blood soaks his gloves, staining the dog's fur red as he holds her tight. "I know, girl," he chants, "I know, I know. We...we are going to be okay. You and me, girl. Anyu, right? That was your name?" The dog peers up into his eyes. "We will be okay, Anyu. I promise you."
cardData.flavorZh: 伊里亚蜷缩在一棵树旁坐着，一阵大雪在他的周围落下。安雨在他的臂弯里呜咽着。鲜血浸湿了他的手套，他紧紧地抱着狗，狗的皮毛都被染成了红色。“我知道，小姑娘。”他念叨着，“我知道，我知道。我们……我们会没事的。你和我都会没事的，小姑娘。安雨，对吧？那是你的名字吗？”大狗抬头看着他的眼睛。“我们会没事的，安雨。我向你保证。”

cardData.flavor: Danforth screams and throws his covers aside. Sweat drenches his forehead and drips down his cheeks. "Just a dream," he whispers. "Just a dream, just a dream." He collapses from his bed, dabs his head with a handkerchief, and wanders over to the nearby window to peer outside. The shape he sees on the other side causes him to leap back in fear, crashing into the opposite wall. "No...no!"
cardData.flavorZh: 丹佛斯尖叫着把被子扔到一边。汗水浸透了他的前额，从他的脸颊上滴下来。“这只是个梦。”他低语着，“只是个梦，只是个梦。”他从床上倒了下来，用手帕轻轻擦了擦脑袋，然后走到旁边的窗口向外张望。他看到另一边的影子，吓得向后一跳，撞上对面的墙。“不……不！”

cardData.flavor:
Dyer shakes the man's hand vigorously, a smile beaming across his face. "You have no idea how much this means to me," he exclaims. "This will be a journey of profound importance. For all of us."
You recognize the man he speaks to - it is the late Professor Lake, one of many who ventured with Dyer to Antarctica and never returned.
"Yes, William," Lake replies, his eyes dribbling over with terrible black ichor. "This expedition will change everything."
cardData.flavorZh:
戴尔使劲捏着那个男子的手，脸上洋溢着笑容。“你不知道这对我有多重要。”他大声说道，“这将是一次意义深远的旅程。对我们所有人来说都是。”
你认出了和他说话的那个人——已故的莱克教授，他是和戴尔一起去南极冒险并再也没有回来的众多人员之一。
“是的，威廉。”莱克回答道，他的眼睛里流淌着可怕的黑色脓液。“这次探险将改变一切。”

cardData.flavor: A young Dr. Sinha appears by the bedside, her face contorted with grief. You have never seen her so stricken. A nurse places a hand on top of Dr. Sinha's in consolation, but she bats it away. "Don't," she barks, choking back a sob. "There is nothing more you could have done, Doctor," the nurse says. "There is always more that can be done," Dr. Sinha shouts. "We could have been smarter! Faster!" Her hands shake as she tries to make a fist. Black miasma seeps from between her knuckles. "We - I - this is my fault. All my fault."
cardData.flavorZh:
年轻的辛哈医生出现在床边，她的脸因悲伤而扭曲。你从未见过她如此伤心。一名护士把手放在辛哈医生的手上安慰她，但她把手挥开了。“不要。”她哽咽着尖叫。
“你已经做到最好了，医生。”护士说。
“不，我永远都应该做得更好。” 辛哈医生喊道，“我们本可以更聪明！更快！”她想握拳，但双手却颤抖起来。黑色瘴气从她的指缝间渗出。“我们——我——这是我的错。都是我的错。”

cardData.flavor: Dr. Kensler sits at her desk, struggling to focus on her work. Various papers sit in neat piles around her, and the bookshelf is perfectly ordered, just as you would expect from the professor. But the journal she writes in is cluttered and unkempt. She runs her hand through her hair, undoing her ponytail. "No, no, no..." she mutters, ripping a piece of paper from the book. You spot a photograph serving as a bookmark, keeping her page as she shuts the journal angrily. She opens one of her desk drawers and throws the crumpled paper inside, barely noticing the way the drawer bubbles over with miasma, and the putrid gray mist emanating from within...
cardData.flavorZh: 肯斯勒博士坐在办公桌前，努力将精神集中在工作上。各种各样的文件整齐地堆放在她的周围，书架上整齐有序，就跟你认为教授应该的样子一样。但她写的日记却凌乱不堪。她用手梳理头发，解开马尾辫。“不，不，不……”她喃喃地说着，从书上撕下一张纸。你在她生气地合上日记时注意到一张作为书签的照片夹在书页之间。她打开一个抽屉，把那张皱巴巴的纸扔了进去，全然不在乎抽屉里正冒着瘴气泡，还有从里面散发出来的腐烂的灰色烟雾……

cardData.flavor:
Through the din of war - a hail of gunfire and mortars so loud it shakes the earth - Cookie reloads his rifle, slowly and methodically. "Sergeant Fredericks!" a voice calls out to him. His companion ducks through the trench as another nearby explosion kicks up a spray of mud. "Germans broke the line last night. They're circling around. We have to get out of here!"
Cookie affixes a bayonet to the end of his rifle. "Did the lieutenant give the order?" he asks.
"Lieutenant Williams is dead," the soldier replies, the fear in his voice palpable. "Sir...you're in charge."
cardData.flavorZh:
在战争的喧闹声——枪声和迫击炮声震得大地都为之摇动——之中，曲奇缓慢而有条不紊地重新装填好步枪。“弗雷德里克斯中士！”一个声音喊道。他的同伴俯身穿过壕沟，附近的另一次爆炸扬起了泥水。“德国人昨晚突破阵线了。他们在周围打转。我们必须离开这里！”
曲奇在他的步枪末端绑上了刺刀。“中尉下命令了吗？”他问道。
“威廉斯中尉死了。”士兵回答，声音里透着恐惧，“长官……现在由您指挥。”

"According to Inuit legend, this megalith has stood here since before humanity walked the Earth," a young Avery recounts, examining the runic language along its surface.
"I don't know about any of that, but it is definitely ancient. That's not even the weirdest part, though."
"What is?" one of the other explorers asks, pulling his hood down to get a better view of the towering structure.
"See for yourself," Claypool says, unfolding a map and placing it against the smooth stone. Drawn over the map's surface are many rings and lines depicting various weather patterns. "This thing...is like a lightning rod."
cardData.flavorZh:
“根据因纽特人的传说，这块巨石在人类出现在地球上之前就已经矗立在这里了。”年轻的艾弗里一边沿着它的表面研究符文语言，一边叙述道。“我不懂这些文字，但它毫无疑问是古代的。不过，这还不是最奇怪的部分。”
“那什么是呢？”另一名探险家一边问，一边拉下兜帽，以便更好地欣赏这座高耸的建筑。
“你自己看吧。”克莱普尔说着，展开一张地图，把它放在光滑的石头上。地图表面绘有许多圆环和线条，描绘了不同的天气模式。“这东西……像是避雷针。”

cardData.flavor: "We almost died that day. Anyu and I," the real Eliyah says as the mirage fades. Anyu licks his gloved hand and whines. "We were the only two that survived. And nobody ever believed me when I told them about the creature that attacked us. They turned me into a pariah. I thought...maybe I was crazy, after all." He shudders as he recalls the shape the mirage took. "But now I know. What attacked us that day was real."
cardData.flavorZh: “那天我们差点就死了。安雨和我。”幻景消失时，真正的伊里亚说道。安雨舔着他戴着手套的手，发出呜呜的声音。“只有我们两个幸存了下来。当我将袭击我们的生物相关的事情告诉别人的时候，没人相信我。他们把我贬为了贱民。我想……也许终究是我疯了。”当他回忆起幻景时，不禁战栗起来。“但现在我知道了。那天袭击我们的东西是真实存在的。”

cardData.flavor: "I will never forget that day. The day I lost my first patient." She crosses her arms as the mirage fades. Her eyes are tired and worn. "They tell you it happens to even the best of us, but even so, we are never prepared. I was not foolish enough to vow that I would never lose another one. I knew that was a fantasy." She glances at you knowingly. "Instead, I simply vowed never to get attached. So do not be upset at my distance. It is for my own sake. So if - when - I lose you, I am not lost, myself."
cardData.flavorZh: “我永远忘不了那一天，我第一个病人去世的那天。”当幻景消失时，她交叉双臂。她的眼睛疲倦而疲惫。“他们告诉你，即使是最优秀的人也会遇到这种情况，但即便如此，我们也从来没有准备好。我还没有蠢到发誓再也不会失去另一个病人。我知道那只是幻想。”她会意地瞥了你一眼。“相反，我只是发誓再也不对他人倾注感情。所以不要因为我疏远你而难过。这是为了我自己。所以如果——当——我失去你时，我也不会迷失，我自己。”

"Kid never did make it back," the real Cookie says, grinding his teeth. "Very few of us did that day. And for what?" He spits. The roar of gunfire fades into the distance. "For what?"
cardData.flavorZh:

“那天我们这些人都快死光了。而这是为了什么呢？”他啐了口口水。枪炮声渐渐消失在远处。“为了什么？”

I should have...but I was too greedy, too eager." he chokes. "And now, here I am again. You and I, we have led these people to their ends. Even if we survive, we will never forget what we have done to these people. What we have risked."

cardData.flavor: "It's here, it's here," the real Danforth mutters as he sees the miasma dripping from the cracked window. "It was always here, always here and I returned, returned to hear that accursed sound..." He continues to watch in horror as the miasma retreats, returning his dormitory to its natural state. It takes several minutes for him to stop shaking.
cardData.flavorZh: “它在这里，它在这里。”真正的丹佛斯看到从破裂的窗户溢出的瘴气，喃喃自语道。“它一直在这里，一直在这里，而我回来了，回来就为了听到那个可恶的声音……”他继续惊恐地看着瘴气退去，宿舍恢复了正常状态。几分钟后他才停止颤抖。

cardData.flavor:
"After that, there was no going back," the real Claypool explains. "We had opened Pandora's box, so to speak. I could no longer bury my head in the sand. There are forces out there beyond our comprehension. Things that science cannot explain. Just as I could not explain that stone's meteorological impact on the region. Nor could I explain the nature of the storm that hit us after we uncovered it."
You ask Claypool what happened to the other man who was with him that day. He grinds his teeth and shakes his head.
cardData.flavorZh:
“从那以后，就没有回头路了。”真正的克莱普尔解释说，“可以说，我们打开了潘朵拉之盒。我再也不能逃避现实了。世上存在我们无法理解的力量。科学无法解释的东西。就像我无法解释那石头对那个地区的气象影响一样，我也无法解释在我们发现后袭击我们的风暴的性质。”
你询问克莱普尔，那天和他在一起的另一个人发生了什么。他咬着牙，摇着头。

cardData.flavor: "I...I remember this," the real Ellsworth says, staring at his own memory. "This is what made me want to become an explorer. To discover things like this. Ancient secrets, left behind by God knows what. But the more I discover, the more I think that perhaps there are parts of the Earth better left alone. Perhaps all of this is the fault of people like me, who refuse to let history lie. Arrogant fools, the lot of us."
cardData.flavorZh: “我……我记得这个。”真正的埃尔斯沃思盯着自己的记忆说，“这就是为什么我想成为一名探险家的原因。为了发现这样的东西。古代秘密，天知道是被什么东西留下来的。但我发现得越多，我就越觉得，不去探索地球的某些地方会更好。也许这一切都是像我这样的人的错，我们这些拒绝让历史被尘封的人。我们都是傲慢的傻瓜。”

cardData.flavor: Dr. Kensler - the real one - eyes you coldly. "This memory is not for you," she warns. "Though I suppose you have no more control over this than I do." You cannot help but be a little curious what kind of academic work would rattle somebody like her, so you ask. "It was not academic in nature," she confesses, running her hand idly along the vision of her office desk, before pulling the photograph out from inside the journal and examining it in private. "I was never very skilled in expressing myself in...matters of the heart," she says, and the photograph fades in her hands, along with the rest of the mirage. "Come along. I do not wish to remain here any longer," she states.
cardData.flavorZh: 肯斯勒博士——真正的那位——冷眼看着你。“你不该接触这段记忆。”她警告着，“不过我想你和我一样，对当前处境也没有什么决定权。”你不禁好奇，什么样的学术工作会让像她这样的人感到不安，所以你向她发问。“这不是学术性质的。”她坦白道，一边漫不经心地抚摸着她的办公桌，然后从日记里抽出照片，私下里检查它。“我从来都不擅长……表达自己内心的想法。”她说着，照片在她手中慢慢消失，幻景中的其他东西也一同消失了。“走吧。我不想再待在这里了。”她说着。

cards.name: Forbidden Peaks

cards.textZh: 强制 - 在你移动到一个地点后：将你所有线索放回供应堆。
cards.backText:
Put the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy into play at the highest level location with one or more investigators. Each investigator at that location loses control of all [[Expedition]] assets and places them at their location.
Read Scenario Interlude: Tragedy Strikes in the Campaign Guide.
cards.backTextZh:
将放在一边的星之恐怖敌人放置入场，位于高度最高的，有调查员的地点。所有位于该地点的调查员各自失去其对所有[[探险]]支援的控制权，并将那些支援放在自己所处的地点。
阅读剧本手册中的冒险幕间故事：悲剧袭来。

cardData.backFlavor: The mountainside splits and erupts with snow. A storm of jagged ice shards bursts forth from the womb of the mountain. Behind it, the beast emerges: a whirlwind of mist; haunting, alien shapes; hideous effluvia. It sets its terrible gaze on your party and reaches for you with a tendril of miasma.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 山腰裂开，雪花喷了出来。一股凌乱的冰屑风暴从山腹中爆发。在其之后，野兽出现了：一团迷雾旋风；令人难忘的异形身影；可怕的臭气。它惊悚的眼神死死盯着你们，带着一缕瘴气向你袭来。
cardData.backText:
Put the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy into play at the highest level location with one or more investigators. Each investigator at that location loses control of all [[Expedition]] assets and places them at their location.
Read Scenario Interlude: Tragedy Strikes in the Campaign Guide.
cardData.backTextZh:
将放在一边的星之恐怖敌人放置入场，位于高度最高的，有调查员的地点。所有位于该地点的调查员各自失去其对所有[[探险]]支援的控制权，并将那些支援放在自己所处的地点。
阅读剧本手册中的冒险幕间故事：悲剧袭来。
cardData.flavor: You arrive at the foothills of the menacing mountain. The strange caves and odd formations at the mountain's summit beg to be explored.
cardData.flavorZh: 你来到了险恶山脉的山麓下。山顶的奇异洞穴和奇怪构造亟待探索。

cards.name: Terror Descends
cards.text: Forced - After you move to a location: Return all of your clues to the token pool.
cards.textZh: 强制 - 在你移动到一个地点后：将你所有线索放回供应堆。
cards.backText:
If one or more investigators have resigned, proceed to (→R1).
Otherwise, proceed to (→R2).
cards.backTextZh:
如果有调查员已经撤退，进入(→结局1)。
否则，进入(→结局2)。

cardData.backFlavor: The snowfall is so thick now that you can no longer see your destination, nor can you hear your companions' shouts over the howling wind. Every step takes the breath out of you. The air is so thin up here, it is a wonder you even have any breath to spare. You glance up at the blanket of white cast in an endless net overhead. Perhaps you were never close to the summit - just another trick of the eye, like everything else in this godforsaken place.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 雪下得如此之大，目的地已从你的视野中消失，你同伴的呼喊也无法越过咆哮的狂风传入你耳中。你走的每一步都让你喘不过气来。这里的空气太稀薄了，你还能呼吸已经是个奇迹。你抬头望着头顶上投下的白茫茫的无尽之网。也许你从来没有接近过山顶——就像这个鬼地方的一切，不过是另一种障眼法。
cardData.backText:
If one or more investigators have resigned, proceed to (→R1).
Otherwise, proceed to (→R2).
cardData.backTextZh:
如果有调查员已经撤退，进入(→结局1)。
否则，进入(→结局2)。
cardData.flavor: The once-flurrying snow has become a tempest of wind and heavy snowfall. If you don't make it across the peaks soon, you'll be forced to take shelter...or spend the rest of eternity as a frozen corpse along the mountainside.
cardData.flavorZh: 曾经的小雪变成了狂风暴雪。如果你不能尽快越过山峰，你就得被迫寻找避难所……或者永远变成山坡上一具冻僵的尸体。

cards.name: Ascend the Mountain
cards.text:
[action]: Take control of an [[Expedition]] asset at your location.
Objective - Get to the top of the mountain. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
cards.textZh:
[action]：控制你所在地点的一个[[探险]]支援。
目标 - 到达山顶。如果所有未被击败的调查员都撤退了，推进场景。

cardData.backFlavor: After a long and arduous journey up the mountainside, you've reached the forbidden peaks. You hope the pain and horror you've suffered along the way is behind you, but you fear that it will persist...and become relentless.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 经过漫长艰难的登山之旅，你已到达失落山峰。你希望一路承受的痛苦与恐惧都已抛诸脑后，却担心它会继续折磨你……永不停歇。
cardData.flavor: Carrying as much expedition gear as you can, you must climb the imposing mountainside to unlock the secrets that lie on the other side.
cardData.flavorZh: 你带着尽可能多的探险装备，必须爬上险峻的山坡去解开另一边的秘密。

cards.backTextZh: 阅读剧本手册中的冒险幕间故事：凝视疯狂。

cardData.backFlavor: The walls of the city call to you in surreptitious whispers, ethereal songs indecipherable to human ears, and yet somehow familiar all the same. You try your best to shut them out, to make believe it is just your imagination, but not all of your companions are as successful...
cardData.backFlavorZh: 城市的城墙偷偷呼唤着你，这是人类耳朵听不懂的空灵歌曲，但不知怎么的，却还是那么熟悉。你尽全力让声音不进入脑海，假装这只是你的想像，但你的所有同伴并非都能成功……

cardData.backFlavor:
Your thoughts become convoluted, a tangle of fear, worry, and doubt. Danger lurks around every corner of this abominable place, but most dangerous of all is the growing feeling that you should not be here - that you should flee from this place and never return.
As the weather outside turns foul, you hole up in the relative safety of one of the city's towering structures. It is too late to return to camp. Your only hope is to take shelter within the alien city, hoping your presence goes unnoticed by the denizens that still prowl through its streets and ancient halls.
cardData.backFlavorZh:
你的想法变得错综复杂，恐惧、担心和怀疑交织在一起。危险潜伏在这个令人厌恶的地方每一个角落，但最危险的是，你越来越觉得你不应该呆在这里——你应该逃离这个地方，永远不要回来。
当外面的天气变坏时，你躲在这座城市高楼中相对安全的一个地方。现在已经太迟了，没法回营地了。你唯一的希望是在这个城市中避难，祈祷你的存在不会被仍然徘徊在它的街道和古老大厅里的居民注意到。
cardData.flavor: Below the darkened ice, more of the city lies trapped, encased and frozen in time. This is but the tip of the iceberg...
cardData.flavorZh: 在黑暗的冰层下，城市更多部分都被困在那里，冰封于时间的长河中。这只是冰山一角……

cards.name: Sprawling City (v. I)
cards.text:
[action] Spend two [elder_thing] keys: Remember that the team "studied the history of the Elder Things."
[action] Spend two [tablet] keys: Remember that the team "discerned the origin of the Shoggoths."
Objective - If the team has "studied the history of the Elder Things" and "discerned the origin of the Shoggoths," advance.
cards.textZh:
[action]花费2个[elder_thing]钥匙：请记住队伍“研究了古老者的历史”。
[action]花费2个[tablet]钥匙：请记住队伍“了解了修格斯的起源”。
目标 - 如果队伍“研究了古老者的历史”且“了解了修格斯的起源”，推进场景。
cards.backText:
Shuffle the set-aside Shoggoths encounter set and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
You know the route into the undercity. Reveal the Hidden Tunnel.
Put the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy into play at the Hidden Tunnel, exhausted.
cards.backTextZh:
将放在一边的修格斯遭遇组和遭遇弃牌库混洗入遭遇牌库。
你知道去地下城市的通路。揭示隐秘隧道。
将放在一边的星之恐怖敌人放置入场，位于隐秘隧道，处于横置状态。

cardData.backFlavor:
What you have found is almost too wild to believe. According to the murals and records within the city, the "Elder Things" were travelers from the stars. They colonized the Earth long before the time of humanity, settling far and wide. And deep in the undercity beneath the tallest mountain, they created monstrous creatures - "Shoggoths" - to be their servants. But the Shoggoths rebelled against them and soon their civilization collapsed...
Suddenly, a distant noise stops you and the other explorers in their tracks: a deep, bellowing roar that seems to come from somewhere far below. You dare not ponder what kind of monstrosity could have made such a hideous sound.
cardData.backFlavorZh:
你的发现简直太疯狂了，让人难以置信。根据城里的壁画和记录，“古老者”是来自繁星的旅者。早在人类出现之前，它们就在地球上殖民，定居范围非常宽广。在最高山脉下的地下城市深处，它们创造了怪异生物——“修格斯”——作为它们的仆人。但修格斯反抗了它们，它们的文明很快就崩溃了……
突然，远处传来声音阻止了你和其他探险者的脚步：一种低沉的咆哮声，似乎来自下面远处的某个地方。你不敢想像是什么样的怪物会发出如此可怕的声音。
cardData.backText:
Shuffle the set-aside Shoggoths encounter set and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
You know the route into the undercity. Reveal the Hidden Tunnel.
Put the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy into play at the Hidden Tunnel, exhausted.
cardData.backTextZh:
将放在一边的修格斯遭遇组和遭遇弃牌库混洗入遭遇牌库。
你知道去地下城市的通路。揭示隐秘隧道。
将放在一边的星之恐怖敌人放置入场，位于隐秘隧道，处于横置状态。
cardData.flavor: This is the discovery of a lifetime. Dyer's report was true - all of it. You must explore this alien civilization in order to learn more...
cardData.flavorZh: 这是一生难得的发现。戴尔的报告是真的——全部内容都是。你必须探索这个异星文明，以便了解更多……

And deep in the undercity beneath the tallest mountain, they found a dormant, primordial power - something so terrifying, they built a gateway to seal it within. But eventually, it began to escape, and their civilization collapsed...
There must be even more preposterous secrets buried deep below. You have to learn the truth of this ancient power, and in order to do so, you must find the secret passageway that will lead you deeper into the heart of the mountain.

Suddenly, a distant noise stops you and the other explorers in their tracks: a deep, bellowing roar that seems to come from somewhere far below. You dare not ponder what kind of monstrosity could have made such a hideous sound.
cardData.backFlavorZh:
你的发现简直太疯狂了，让人难以置信。根据这座城市的壁画和记录，一个被称为“修格斯”的怪物种族被创造出来为这座城市的主人服务。修格斯被派遣到最高山脉下的地下城深处，在那里它们将建造一个大门来封印某种蛰伏中的远古力量，这种力量是如此可怕，以至于修格斯的主人都害怕它。但修格斯反抗了主人，让封印衰弱，导致了这个古老文明的崩溃……
突然，远处传来声音阻止了你和其他探险者的脚步：一种低沉的咆哮声，似乎来自下面远处的某个地方。你不敢想像是什么样的怪物会发出如此可怕的声音。
cardData.backText:
Shuffle the set-aside Shoggoths encounter set and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
You know the route into the undercity. Reveal the Hidden Tunnel.
In player order, each investigator draws 1 card from the top of the encounter deck.
cardData.backTextZh:
将放在一边的修格斯遭遇组和遭遇弃牌库混洗入遭遇牌库。
你知道去地下城市的通路。揭示隐秘隧道。
按玩家顺序，每位调查员抽取遭遇牌库顶的1张卡牌。
cardData.flavor: This is the discovery of a lifetime. Dyer's report was true - all of it. You must explore this alien civilization in order to learn more...
cardData.flavorZh: 这是一生难得的发现。戴尔的报告是真的——全部内容都是。你必须探索这个异星文明，以便了解更多……

cardData.flavorZh: 在这个由结冰的街道和巨大建筑构成的庞大网络某处，有一个通往宏伟山脉底下的地下城市的古老大门。如果你想了解更多的话，你必须找到它……

cards.name: Hidden Tunnel
cards.text:
Clues on Hidden Tunnel cannot be discovered or moved to other locations.
[action]: Test a skill of your choice (4). You may spend a [skull] key to get +5 skill value for this test. If you succeed, return 1 clue on Hidden Tunnel to the token pool (2 clues instead if you spent a [skull] key).
cards.textZh:
隐秘隧道上的线索不能被发现或移动到其他地点。
[action]：任选一项技能检定(4)。你可以花费一个[skull]钥匙来使你本次检定得到技能值+5。如果你检定成功，将隐秘隧道上的1个线索返回到供应堆(如果你花费了一个[skull]钥匙，改为2个线索)。
cards.backText: The passageway into the undercity is hidden. You cannot enter the Hidden Tunnel.
cards.backTextZh: 进入地下城市的通道被隐藏了。你不能进入隐秘隧道。

cardData.backFlavor: "...our study of the decadent sculptures brought about a change in our immediate objective. This of course had to do with the chiselled avenues to the black inner world, of whose existence we had not known before...." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
cardData.backFlavorZh: “……我们对堕落雕画的研究使我们的当前目标发生了变化。这当然与开凿的通往黑暗内部世界的通道有关，而我们以前并不知道它的存在……”H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》

cards.name: Ancient Planetarium
cards.text: [action] Spend two "0" keys: Add one of the spent "0" keys to the chaos bag (as a chaos token) for the remainder of the campaign. Record in the Campaign Log the team photographed the astronomical charts.
cards.textZh: [action]花费2个“0”钥匙：直到剧本结束，在混乱袋里加入花费的其中一个“0”钥匙(作为一个混乱标记)。在剧本日志中记录队伍拍摄了天文图的照片。

cardData.backFlavor: "Yet now the sway of reason seemed irrefutably shaken, for this Cyclopean maze of squared, curved, and angled blocks had features which cut off all comfortable refuge. It was, very clearly, the blasphemous city of the mirage in stark, objective, and ineluctable reality." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
cardData.backFlavorZh: “但现在这令人信服的理由似乎已无可辩驳地动摇了，因为这个由方形、弧形和有棱角的石块组成的巨大迷宫拥有的特征把一切舒适的退路都切断了。很明显，幻景中那座亵渎之城是赤裸裸的、客观的、无可逃避的现实。”H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》

cards.name: The Heart of Madness
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if there is an [[Ancient One]] enemy at your location).
[cultist]: -1. If there is a seal at your location, or if your location is a Mist-Pylon, treat this token as a [frost] token, instead.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, draw the top card of the Tekeli-li deck.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail by 3 or more, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This can cause the current agenda to advance.
cards.textZh:
简单/ 普通
[skull]：-1(如果你所在地点有[[古神]]敌人，改为-3)。
[cultist]：-1。如果你所在地点有封印，或者你所在地点是迷雾高塔，改为将本标记视为[frost]标记。
[tablet]：-3。如果你检定失败，抽取忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的1张卡牌。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你检定失败且低于难度至少3点，在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致当前密谋推进。

cards.name: The Gate of Y'quaa
cards.text:
[action]: Place an activated seal you control on The Gate of Y'quaa.
[action]: Resign. You retreat, hoping you've done enough to seal away whatever lies beyond the gate. (If you control 1 or more seals, you retain control of them.)
cards.textZh:
[action]：将你控制的一个激活的封印放在伊夸之门上。
[action]：撤退。你撤退了，希望你已经做了足够的工作，能够把大门彼端的东西封印起来(如果你控制着1个或更多封印，你保留它们的控制权)。
cards.backText: A wall of churning miasma blocks the ancient gateway. Investigators and enemies cannot enter The Gate of Y'quaa. The Gate of Y'quaa cannot have attachments.
cards.backTextZh: 一堵翻滚的瘴气之墙挡住了古老的大门，调查员和敌人不能进入伊夸之门。伊夸之门不能拥有附属。

cardData.backFlavor: -the black pit - the carven rim - the proto-shoggoths - the windowless solids with five dimensions - the nameless cylinder - the elder pharos - the primal white jelly - the wings - the eyes in darkness - the moon-ladder - the original - the eternal - the undying-
cardData.backFlavorZh: ——黑色深坑——洞穴边——原初修格斯——没有窗户的五维实体——无名圆柱——古老灯塔——原始白色胶状物——翅膀——黑暗中的眼睛——登月梯——起源——永恒——不朽——

cards.name: The Beating Heart
cards.text: Forced - If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)
cards.textZh: 强制 - 如果在同一地点有至少2个由调查员控制的激活的封印：储存在封印内的潜在能量聚合在一起，随后的连锁反应引发静电爆炸，摧毁了地球上的所有生命。(→结局3)
cards.backText: Read Scenario Interlude: The Final Straw in the Campaign Guide.
cards.backTextZh: 阅读剧本手册中的冒险幕间故事：最后一根稻草。

cardData.backFlavor: A dark, primordial energy seeps forth from the walls, the very same miasma that has haunted your every step throughout this doomed journey. You freeze in your tracks and back away. You've seen the kinds of hideous shapes it can take. The kinds of memories it conjures- foul and fair alike. But not everyone sees the mirage for what it truly is...
cardData.backFlavorZh: 一种黑暗、原始的能量从墙壁中渗出，正是在这末日之旅中缠绕着你前进路程上每一步的瘴气。你停下脚步，开始后退。你已经见识过它会变成什么样的可怕形状，它所能唤起的那些记忆——不论肮脏还是美好的。但并不是每个人都能看到幻景的真实面目……
cardData.backText: Read Scenario Interlude: The Final Straw in the Campaign Guide.
cardData.backTextZh: 阅读剧本手册中的冒险幕间故事：最后一根稻草。
cardData.flavor: Five darkened paths lead away from the gateway, through icy caverns and down vaulted corridors of smooth black stone. Quiet dread fills the ancient, dormant structure.
cardData.flavorZh: 五道黑暗的通路从大门向外延伸，穿过冰封的洞穴和光滑的黑石拱廊。寂静的恐怖遍布这古老沉寂的建筑。

cards.backText:
Check the seals controlled by each investigator (if a seal is not controlled by an investigator, skip it).
The investigator who controls the [seal_a] seal takes 1 damage (2 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_b] seal discards 2 random cards from their hand (4 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_c] seal takes 1 horror (2 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_d] seal loses 1 action (2 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_e] seal loses 3 resources (6 instead if the seal is activated).

检查由每位调查员控制的封印(如果有封印不是由调查员控制的，跳过它)。
控制[seal_a]封印的调查员受到1点伤害(如果封印是激活的，改为2点)。

控制[seal_c]封印的调查员受到1点恐惧(如果封印是激活的，改为2点)。
控制[seal_d]封印的调查员失去1个行动(如果封印是激活的，改为2个)。
控制[seal_e]封印的调查员失去3资源(如果封印是激活的，改为6资源)。

cards.backText: Each remaining investigator is defeated and must either suffer 1 mental trauma or shuffle the top 3 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck.
cards.backTextZh: 剩余的每位调查员被击败，且必须承受1点精神创伤，或者将忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的3张卡牌混洗入各自的牌库。

cardData.backFlavor: Before you can find and place all five seals, a tremendous noise fills the cavernous halls of the facility, and inky, prismatic miasma begins to seep from every inch of the walls and ceiling. Waves of creeping ichor and wafting black mist block every route but the one from which you came. You flee back to the gateway to escape or find another path forward, but by the time you reach the massive door, it is too late.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 在你成功找到并放置所有五个封印之前，巨大的噪音响彻洞穴般的大厅，五彩的墨状瘴气开始从墙壁和天花板的每一寸渗透出来。大量蠕动的脓水和飘来的黑雾挡住了每一条路，除了你来的那条。你向大门口逃去，试图逃跑或找到另一条路前进，但当你到达大门时，已经太迟了。
cardData.backText: Each remaining investigator is defeated and must either suffer 1 mental trauma or shuffle the top 3 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck.
cardData.backTextZh: 剩余的每位调查员被击败，且必须承受1点精神创伤，或者将忒咳哩-哩牌库顶的3张卡牌混洗入各自的牌库。
cardData.flavor: The gateway stirs. Whatever is calling to you from within these walls, it hears your every word, your every footstep. It knows of your presence, of your hopes, of your fears. And it yearns to be free.
cardData.flavorZh: 大门骚动着。无论墙里有什么在召唤你，它都能听到你说的每一个字，你的每一步。它知道你的存在，你的希望，你的恐惧。而且它渴望自由。

cards.name: Dormancy
cards.text: Objective - If an activated seal is placed on The Gate of Y'quaa, advance.
cards.textZh: 目标 - 如果一个激活的封印被放到伊夸之门上，推进场景。
cards.backText:
Check which seal was just placed (do not remove it).
If it was the [seal_a] seal, the investigator who placed it heals 1 damage.
If it was the [seal_b] seal, the investigator who placed it draws 2 cards.
If it was the [seal_c] seal, the investigator who placed it heals 1 horror.
If it was the [seal_d] seal, the investigator who placed it may take an additional action this turn.
If it was the [seal_e] seal, the investigator who placed it gains 3 resources.
cards.backTextZh:
检查刚刚放置的是哪个封印(不要移除它)。
如果是[seal_a]封印，放置该封印的调查员治愈1点伤害。
如果是[seal_b]封印，放置该封印的调查员抽取2张卡牌。
如果是[seal_c]封印，放置该封印的调查员治愈1点恐惧。
如果是[seal_d]封印，放置该封印的调查员本回合可以执行额外一个行动。
如果是[seal_e]封印，放置该封印的调查员获得3资源。

cardData.backFlavor: As soon as you set the seal into place, it locks into the door with an audible click. The energy stored within the seal reaches out, coursing through channels and grooves along the doorway, and lighting the entire chamber with an eerie glow. Perhaps if you can activate and place the remaining four seals, you can put a stop to this madness.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 一旦你将封印放对位置，随着咔嗒一声，它就锁在了门上。储存在封印内的能量顺着管道和凹槽延伸，照亮了整个房间，发出一种怪异的光芒。也许如果你能激活并放置剩下的四个封印，你就能阻止这场疯狂。

cardData.flavor: You have decided to explore the rest of this antediluvian complex in order to find the devices that fit this strange doorway.
cardData.flavorZh: 为了找到能安装在这个奇怪大门上的设备，你决定探索这片远古建筑群的其余部分。

cardData.packName: Edge of the Earth Campaign Expansion

cards.name: The Great Seal
cards.text: Objective - Place as many activated seals as you can on The Gate of Y'quaa before whatever is inside escapes. If all five seals have been placed, advance.
cards.textZh: 目标 - 在里面的东西逃离前，在伊夸之门上放置尽可能多的激活的封印。如果放置了所有五个封印，推进场景。

cardData.backFlavor: The final seal locks into place. With a hum, power flows through the facility. Small orbs embedded in the ceiling begin to light, one by one. The realization dawns on you that this sanctuary is far more advanced than you could have ever imagined.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 最后的封印归位。随着一阵嗡嗡声，能量流过整个设施。嵌在天花板上的小球体开始一个接一个地亮起来。你意识到这个圣所比你想像的要先进得多。
cardData.flavor: Placing the first of the five seals has awoken a strange power within the facility. You believe if you can find and activate the remaining seals, they will aid in containing the thing that dwells on the other side of this gate...
cardData.flavorZh: 放置了五个封印中的第一个后，设施中的某种奇怪力量被唤醒了。你相信如果你能找到并激活剩下的封印，它们将有助于控制潜伏在这扇门彼端的东西……

cards.name: Glacial Grotto
cards.text:
Forced - After Glacial Grotto is revealed: Place the dormant [seal_a] seal on it.
[action]: Test [combat] (2) to shatter the ice. If you succeed, investigators at Glacial Grotto may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, for you to take control of the seal on it.
cards.textZh:
强制 - 在冰川岩洞被揭示后：将休眠的[seal_a]封印放在它上面。
[action]：检定[combat](2)来打碎冰块。如果你检定成功，位于冰川岩洞的调查员可以共同花费1[per_investigator]个线索，来使你控制其上的封印。

cardData.backFlavor: "Other apertures were undoubtedly connected with bygone mechanical facilities - heating, lighting, and the like - of a sort suggested in many of the carvings. Ceilings tended to be plain, but had sometimes been inlaid with green soapstone or other tiles, mostly fallen now." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
cardData.backFlavorZh: “其他的孔洞无疑是与过去的机械设备有关——如供暖、照明等——这在许多雕画中都有所暗示。天花板一般都很平实，但有时也会镶嵌上绿色的皂石或其他瓷砖，而现在大多已经脱落了。”H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》

Hunter.
Spawn - Location farthest from you on the outer ring.
Prey - Nearest investigator with a seal only.
Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if an investigator controls an activated seal: Protoplasmic Mass readies and resolves the enemy phase again (it resolves its hunter keyword and attacks a second time). (Limit once per phase.)

猎手。
生成 - 最外的环形上距离你最远的地点。
猎物 - 仅对拥有封印的最近调查员。
强制 - 在敌军阶段结束时，如果一位调查员控制着激活的封印：重整原生质团并再结算一次敌军阶段(其结算其猎手关键词并再次攻击)。(每个阶段限一次。)

cards.name: The Seal Weakens
cards.backText:
Spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness enemy at the Mist-Pylon nearest to an investigator.
Check the Campaign Log. If the truth of the mirage eludes you:
You stare, dumbstruck, at the hideous phantasmagoria. The air shimmers with a dreamlike quality about its damnable form, an endless weave of intermingled nightmare and memory. The very sight of it drives you to your knees. It is the final truth. Reality was the mirage.
Each investigator searches their deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and draws them one at a time in a random order, without placing them on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. After resolving all of them, shuffle each of them back into their bearer's deck.
cards.backTextZh:
在离一位调查员最近的迷雾高塔生成1张放在一边的无名疯狂敌人。
检查剧本日志。如果你尚未明了幻景的真相：
你呆呆地望着这千变万化的可怕幻景。空气中闪烁着梦幻般的光芒，噩梦和记忆在无尽地交织着。一看到它你就不由自主跪了下来。这是终极真相。现实曾是幻景。
每位调查员查找自己牌库，找出其中所有忒咳哩-哩，并依次按随机顺序抽取这些卡牌，且不要将它们放在忒咳哩-哩牌库底。在结算完所有这些卡牌后，将它们各自混洗入承受者的牌库。

cardData.backFlavor: From the nameless depths at the very core of the Earth, the miasma's true form emerges. It is a shapeless thing, a creature of whirling mist and putrid ichor that screams and whispers and crawls and flies. It seeps through the walls and up from the ice; it is everywhere; it is everything.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 从地球最核心的无名深渊中，瘴气的真实形态出现了。那是一种无形，由旋转的雾和腐烂脓液构成的生物，它在尖叫、低语、爬行、飞舞。它穿过墙壁，从冰中渗出；它无处不在；它就是一切。

Spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness enemy at the Mist-Pylon nearest to an investigator.
Check the Campaign Log. If the truth of the mirage eludes you:
You stare, dumbstruck, at the hideous phantasmagoria. The air shimmers with a dreamlike quality about its damnable form, an endless weave of intermingled nightmare and memory. The very sight of it drives you to your knees. It is the final truth. Reality was the mirage.
Each investigator searches their deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and draws them one at a time in a random order, without placing them on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. After resolving all of them, shuffle each of them back into their bearer's deck.
cardData.backTextZh:
在离一位调查员最近的迷雾高塔生成1张放在一边的无名疯狂敌人。
检查剧本日志。如果你尚未明了幻景的真相：
你呆呆地望着这千变万化的可怕幻景。空气中闪烁着梦幻般的光芒，噩梦和记忆在无尽地交织着。一看到它你就不由自主跪了下来。这是终极真相。现实曾是幻景。
每位调查员查找自己牌库，找出其中所有忒咳哩-哩，并依次按随机顺序抽取这些卡牌，且不要将它们放在忒咳哩-哩牌库底。在结算完所有这些卡牌后，将它们各自混洗入承受者的牌库。
cardData.flavor: Miasma has completely consumed this part of the facility. The walls and ceiling drip with polychromatic ooze, polar mist swirls through the halls, and the air shimmers with the insubstantial quality of a mirage. What manner of power is this? And how can you possibly hope to destroy it?
cardData.flavorZh: 瘴气已经完全吞噬了设施的这一部分。墙壁和天花板上滴落着色彩不断变化的软泥，极地迷雾在大厅里盘旋，空气闪烁着虚幻的微光。这是什么样的力量？而你又能怎样毁掉它？

cards.backText:
For each Mist-Pylon that is collapsed, set 3 copies of The Nameless Madness aside.
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Remove each location except The Gate of Y'quaa from the game. Investigators and copies of The Nameless Madness are not defeated by this effect. All other cards at these locations are discarded.
Put the 4 set-aside Titanic Ramp locations into play in a straight line to the right of The Gate of Y'quaa. Put the set-aside Hidden Tunnel location into play to the right of the rightmost Titanic Ramp. Place each investigator and each remaining copy of The Nameless Madness in play at the leftmost Titanic Ramp.
Remove the act deck from the game and advance to the set-aside The Final Mirage. It is both the current act and the current agenda.
cards.backTextZh:

每位调查员失去其所有线索。

cards.name: Collapse the Pylons
cards.text:
Each revealed Mist-Pylon can be attacked as if it were an enemy. Its fight value is equal to its shroud value and its health is equal to its clue value. While it has no health remaining, it is collapsed (it remains in play).
[reaction] When you discover 1 or more clues at a Mist-Pylon, spend those clues: Deal that much damage to that Mist-Pylon.
Objective - At the end of the round, if each Mist-Pylon is collapsed, advance this act.
cards.textZh:
每个已揭示的迷雾高塔可以被攻击，如同它是敌人。它的战斗值等于它的隐藏值，它的生命值等于它的线索值。它没有剩余生命值时，它被摧毁(它依然保持在场上)。
[reaction]在你发现迷雾高塔上的1个或更多线索时，花费那些线索：对该迷雾高塔造成该数量的伤害。

cards.name: The Nameless Madness
cards.text:
Alert. Massive. Retaliate.
The Nameless Madness cannot take damage.
Forced - After you successfully evade or attack The Nameless Madness: For each point you succeeded by, exhaust the nearest ready copy of The Nameless Madness.
cards.textZh:
警戒。庞大。反击。
无名疯狂不能受到伤害。
强制 - 你成功躲避或攻击无名疯狂后：你每超过难度1点，横置最近的一个重整状态的无名疯狂。

cards.name: Unsealed Phantasm
cards.text:
Spawn - The nearest Mist-Pylon that is not collapsed (or your location, if there are none in play).
While Unsealed Phantasm is ready and at a Mist-Pylon, damage cannot be dealt to that Mist-Pylon.
Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Unsealed Phantasm is ready: Move it once toward the Mist-Pylon nearest to it that is not collapsed.
cards.textZh:
生成 - 最近的未被摧毁的迷雾高塔(如果场上没有，则为你所在地点)。
解开封印的幻影处于重整状态且位于一个迷雾高塔时，不能对该迷雾高塔造成伤害。
强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果解开封印的幻影处于重整状态：将其朝最近的未被摧毁的迷雾高塔移动一次。

cards.name: The Final Mirage
cards.text:
The Nameless Madness gains hunter.
Forced - When 1 or more doom would be put into play: Instead, spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness at the leftmost investigator's location.
Objective - Run.
cards.textZh:
无名疯狂获得猎手。
强制 - 在至少1个毁灭标记将要被放置入场时：改为在最左边的调查员所在地点生成一张放在一边的无名疯狂敌人。
目标 - 跑。
cards.backText:
Check the Campaign Log.
- If all 5 Mist-Pylons were collapsed and Dr. Kensler has a plan, proceed to (→R1).
- If all 5 Mist-Pylons were collapsed and the truth of the mirage eludes you, proceed to (→R2).
- Otherwise, proceed to (→R3).
cards.backTextZh:
检查剧本日志。
- 如果所有5个迷雾高塔都被摧毁，且肯斯勒博士有一个计划，进入(→结局1)。
- 如果所有5个迷雾高塔都被摧毁，且你尚未明了幻景的真相，进入(→结局2)。
- 否则，进入(→结局3)。

cardData.backFlavor: You emerge from the tunnel, daylight blinding you as the sun peeks out from behind the jagged mountaintops in the distance. Behind you, the entity rushes toward the exit. You prepare yourself for the end, the wall of mist, miasma, and madness feeling much like an oncoming train.
cardData.backFlavorZh: 你从隧道里出来，阳光从远处锯齿状的山顶后面探出头，使你目眩。在你身后，那存在也猛冲向出口。你做好面对终结的准备，雾墙、瘴气和疯狂感觉就像一列火车迎面而来。

cards.name: Titanic Ramp
cards.text:
Titanic Ramp is connected to the locations to its left and right.
As an additional cost for you to leave Titanic Ramp, test [agility] (4). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move. Any investigator at your location or a connecting location may spend 1 clue to have you automatically succeed at this test.
cards.textZh:
巨大坡道与其左边和右边的地点连接。
作为离开巨大坡道的额外费用，检定[agility](4)。如果你检定失败，取消本次移动的效果。位于你所在地点或相邻地点的任意调查员，可以花费1个线索来使你本次检定自动成功。
cards.backText: Titanic Ramp is connected to the locations to its left and right.
cards.backTextZh: 巨大坡道与其左边和右边的地点连接。

cardData.backFlavor: "...over our former trail back to the city, along ice-sunken megalithic corridors to the great open circle, and up that archaic spiral ramp in a frenzied automatic plunge for the sane outer air and light of day." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness
cardData.backFlavorZh: “在我们回城路上，沿着被冰淹没的巨石走廊来到那空旷的巨大圆形遗迹，然后沿着古老的螺旋坡道疯狂而机械地往上冲，朝向外面那有着空气和日光的正常世界。”H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特《疯狂山脉》

隐秘隧道与其左边的地点连接。

cardData.backFlavor: "Thank heaven we did not slacken our run. The curling mist had thickened again, and was driving ahead with increased speed; whilst the straying penguins in our rear were squawking and screaming..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

Fast.
[reaction] When you reveal a [frost] token during a skill test you are performing, deal 1 damage to Claypool's Furs: Cancel that chaos token and return it to the bag. Reveal a new chaos token.
cards.textZh:
快速。
[reaction]你执行的技能检定期间，在你揭示一个[frost]标记时，对克莱普尔的皮草造成1点伤害：取消该混乱标记并将其放回混乱袋。揭示一个新的混乱标记。

cards.text:

[action] Spend 1 charge: Choose an investigator at your location to search the top 6 cards of their deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and place each of them on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. Shuffle that investigator's deck. That investigator draws 1 card.
cards.textZh:
使用(3充能)。
[action]花费1充能：选择你所在地点的一位调查员，其查找自己牌库顶的6张卡牌，找出其中所有忒咳哩-哩，并将这些卡牌都放在忒咳哩-哩牌库底。混洗该调查员的牌库。该调查员抽取1张卡牌。

 - Move to a connecting location.
 - You get +2 skill value for your next skill test this round.
 - Evade. Attempt to evade with a base [agility] skill of 4.

- 你本轮下次技能检定中得到技能值+2。
- 躲避。以基础值为4的[agility]尝试躲避。
